title: Woven, Inscribed, Enfolded, Encased: Adinkra from Kumase to the British Museum
version: pp. 6, 13 and 31, cotton strips and 1817 loom

passages.locator: pp. 6, 13 and 31, cotton strips and 1817 loom
passages.note: The article describes foot-loom woven cotton strips joined into larger adinkra cloth, and identifies an example of a loom and unfinished textile from Kumase in Bowdich’s 1817 visit. Regional influences are presented as possibilities.
